comment: Blocks of ts_CastleTop beyond area 0x1B, read by tools/alttp/owdump.py tiles. map16: the frames of the palace door animation (zelda3 kDoorAnimTiles, groups 3 and 4: a 'palace' door opens through them; the closed door is cells 31-32, 5-6 of the area), each 2x2 as top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. recolor: copies of area cells with colors swapped: the grass edges of the dirt path at the bottom of the area, the dirt turned into the teal of the roof, so grass can spread over the terrace (docs/regioes/topo-do-castelo.md). passage: the foot of the walls' corners with the roof's cream turned into the teal of the terrace, so a wall cut by a top door ends as a room's corner does (R1, sixth round).
